metadata.scenario: A person new to the area calls to learn about the community center's programs and activities. Category: General Information. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I assist you today? Hi, my name is Karen Lewis. I'm looking for information about post-operative care for my husband. Of course, Karen. Can you tell me a little more about your husband's upcoming surgery? He’s having cardiac surgery next month and will need care afterward. I see. We can certainly help with post-surgical recovery care. That sounds good. What kind of services do you offer for that? We provide specialized care including wound management, medication management, and health monitoring, typically for $85 to $110 per visit. And how long do those visits usually last? They're scheduled for 1 to 3 hours depending on the level of care needed. That sounds like it would work. Can you explain how the scheduling process works? Certainly! We’ll develop a care plan tailored to his needs and schedule visits based on his recovery timeline. Great! Will you need to communicate with his doctor? Yes, we will coordinate with his healthcare team to ensure continuity of care. Perfect. What about insurance? Do you handle that? We can assist with insurance authorization and help verify your coverage for the services. That’s helpful. I’m a bit stressed about all of this. I understand, Karen. We’re here to make the process as smooth as possible for you. Thank you. What if I have any questions later? You can call back anytime. My extension is 201, and I’m here Monday through Friday. Okay, that's good to know. Can I also schedule a visit to discuss his care plan? Absolutely! We can schedule a meeting with our care coordinator, Lisa Chen. What’s her number? You can reach her directly at +1 316-555-9203. Thank you, I’ll give her a call. Anything else I should know? Once you decide on the services, we’ll set up a care plan and schedule the first visit. Great! I appreciate your help, Margaret. You're welcome, Karen. We look forward to supporting you and your husband. Thank you! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye!
